findings: ETT.tex:1399-1406, with ETT.tex:631-632. The existence half needs (b') at the model spaces, and the proof checks neither hreg nor (b') (recorded finding, OQ-64). At E_0 -> E_0, (b') holds in the readings OQ-34/35, OQ-64 and OQ-82 = SO_0: Causal.BPrimeE0.chartIso_of_isAEChart. It is not a formality. It is prop:isom of brunswic2021cauchy at alpha = beta = 0 (BTZ_1.tex:378-383): near an axis point, every a.e. isomorphism between open subsets of E_0 is a rotation about the axis after a translation along it (exists_eqOn_rotE0_tauShift), and conversely every such map is one (isAEChart_rotE0_tauShift). ETT.tex:1322-1323 promises « the precise reference for each » hypothesis. The paper may want to cite brunswic2021cauchy prop:isom for (b') at the models, in the proof of cor:massA_causalite (l.1399-1406) or at step (B) of prop:GX_sing_espace_temps_topo (l.631-632).

ETT.tex:1396, at the models E_0 only. For E_0-manifolds (A = {0}), the natural absolutely minimal causality exists and is unique with no model hypothesis left: Causal.BPrimeE0.existsUnique_causality_e0, which is existsUnique_causality_singularGX_dec25 with (a), (b), hreg and (b') all discharged. So, in these readings, the existence half of cor:massA_causalite is not refuted at E_0. The target's evidence asked about exactly this (« If (b') fails at E_0, that is a finding for OQ-64 »), and (b') does not fail.

BTZ_1.tex:447 and 453-457 (the author's source paper brunswic2021cauchy, not ETT). « mutatis mutandis » for alpha = 0 hides one step. At alpha = 0 the developed singular line Delta is null, not timelike, so l.455 (« Since the direction of Delta is timelike, g is an elliptic isometry of axis Delta ») does not carry over verbatim. The isometries in SO_0(1,2) x| R^3 preserving the null line are a boost B_mu, mu > 0, after a parabolic H_u, then a translation along Delta (Causal.BPrimeE0.isom_of_null_line). The boost is the paper's own h_ell (l.372-375, l.440), with ell = mu. The developed map is then psi(tau, r e^{i theta}) = (mu tau + (r/mu - mu r)/2 + s/2, (r/mu) e^{i mu (theta + u)}) (eq_of_dev). The analogue of l.461-462 is: mu < 1 is excluded by continuity across a slit (e^{2 pi i mu} != 1; the map does not descend to E_0), and mu > 1 by injectivity (BTZ_1's own remark l.374-375, « injective iff ell = 1 ») (mu_eq_one). The reflection theta -> -theta also preserves Delta, in O^+(1,2) x| R^3. Only the determinant excludes it, i.e. the reading Isom(E^{1,2}) = SO_0(1,2) x| R^3. With these two additions the proof carries over.

ETT.tex:1331 and l.1401 (OQ-82). The reflection theta -> -theta of E_0 (Causal.BPrimeE0.conjE0) is a chart isomorphism of E0.causality (chartIso_conjE0): the closed forms of the relations depend on the angle only through delta^2. Under SO_0(1,2) x| R^3 it is not an a.e. isomorphism chart (not_isAEChart_conjE0). So the answer to OQ-82 changes the class of a.e. isomorphisms of E_0. The maps the O^+ reading adds are still causal isomorphisms, so, as far as the reflection goes, the choice does not decide (b') at E_0. The O^+ statement itself is not proved here.

Roadmap (not the paper). The [r] of T-ett-bprime-e0's evidence says « conjugation by an element of the normaliser of a unipotent of SO_0(1,2) multiplies it by a positive factor, so k = 1 ». This is incomplete. With g = T B_mu H_u, g hol(2 pi) g^{-1} = hol(2 pi mu) (B_mu H_s B_mu^{-1} = H_{mu s}), so the deck relation gives k = mu, a positive integer. k = 1 needs injectivity in addition: mu >= 2 gives the non-injective h_mu. The planner's other points check out: once k = 1, g centralises hol(2 pi) and psi is rotE0 phi o tauShift t near the axis; lambda = 1 when k = 1 (here k = lambda = mu); and under O^+ the reflection (gx's k = -1) appears. The route here does not use the deck relation. It uses one slit box, the limit at the axis, and continuity across the slit.
questions: OQ-64: what is an « isomorphism of the model spaces » (ETT.tex:631-632)? Reading taken: an a.e. isomorphism chart between open subsets of a model (IsAEChart over E0GX.singularGX), and « isomorphism of topological spacetimes » as ChartIso, as in Causal.GXSingularDEC25 and the target block. Not ruled.

OQ-82: which group is Isom(E^{1,2}) (l.1331, l.1401)? Reading taken: SO_0(1,2) x| R^3 (Flat.isom 2), the reading of record. Under it the reflection is excluded by the determinant. Under O^+(1,2) x| R^3 the singular structure of E_0 changes, the reflection becomes an a.e. isomorphism (and is a ChartIso, chartIso_conjE0), and the theorem would have to be restated for that group. Not ruled.
OQ-34/OQ-35: which E_0? Reading taken: Causal.E0, gx's flat extreme-BTZ metric through D, the curve-defined causality (the strict port's reading). Not ruled.

hiso_massAModel_none takes the family of singular structures on the models MassAModel as an instance argument, with its value at E_0 equal to E0GX.singularGX. No such family exists in lean-causal yet: the structure of E_kappa is not built (T-ett-ealpha-gx-structure, T-ett-singular-instance). It is stated this way so that it plugs into massA_singular_dec25_models at o = o' = none once the family is packaged.

kb_proposals: (b') at E_0 is Causal.BPrimeE0.chartIso_of_isAEChart: every IsAEChart E_0 -> E_0 for E0GX.singularGX is a ChartIso of E0.causality. Near an axis point such a chart is rotE0 phi o tauShift t (exists_eqOn_rotE0_tauShift), and every such composite is one (isAEChart_rotE0_tauShift). For E_0-manifolds use existsUnique_causality_e0, with no model hypothesis left.

Rigidity at a singular point without covering spaces (Causal.BPrimeE0). (1) On a slit box the reference sector chart is a single chart, and the class of the reading isometry modulo the holonomy is locally constant (HolRel, IsPreconnected.induction₂'), so one isometry g develops the map. (2) Limits along a ray put g's image of the developed axis on the null line (smul_null_line). (3) Then the stabiliser of the line (isom_of_null_line) and injectivity or continuity across the slit (mu_eq_one). The same scheme should serve E_kappa, kappa > 0, with a timelike axis.

To compute the determinant of an explicit linear map of R x R x R: LinearMap.det_conj with Causal.BPrimeE0.coordsNull, then LinearMap.det_toMatrix' and Matrix.det_fin_three. simp [LinearMap.toMatrix'_apply, coordsNull, h] evaluates the entries, given h : ∀ a b c, N (a, b, c) = (…).

The reflection theta -> -theta of E_0 (Causal.BPrimeE0.conjE0) is a ChartIso, since the closed forms see the angle only through delta^2. Under SO_0 it is not an IsAEChart (not_isAEChart_conjE0). It is a cheap witness that OQ-82's reading changes the a.e. isomorphisms of E_0.
